# Hangul jamo composition cell-run golden fixture
# Unicode 15.0.0 — UAX #29 GB6/GB7/GB8 Hangul composition rules
#
# Without GB6–GB8, consecutive jamo would each be independent clusters.
# With GB6–GB8, they compose into one cluster whose width = base jamo width.
#
# L jamo (U+1100–U+115F): EAW=W, 2 cells each
# V jamo (U+1160–U+11A7): EAW=N, 1 cell each (neutral, not wide)
# T jamo (U+11A8–U+11FF): EAW=N, 1 cell each
# LV syllable (U+AC00–D7A3 where (cp-AC00)%28==0): EAW=W, 2 cells
# LVT syllable (U+AC00–D7A3 where (cp-AC00)%28!=0): EAW=W, 2 cells
#
# Format: description | utf8 bytes (hex) | tab_width → total_cells | spans

# GB6: L × V — leading + vowel jamo compose into 1 cluster
# U+1100 ᄀ (E1 84 80) + U+1161 ᅡ (E1 85 A1) → cluster width=2 (L is wide)
hangul_L_V      | E1 84 80 E1 85 A1          | 4 → 2 | 0:6:2:T

# GB6 + GB7: L × V × T — full syllable from jamo
# U+1100 (E1 84 80) + U+1161 (E1 85 A1) + U+11A8 ᆨ (E1 86 A8)
hangul_L_V_T    | E1 84 80 E1 85 A1 E1 86 A8 | 4 → 2 | 0:9:2:T

# GB7: LV × T — pre-composed LV syllable + trailing jamo
# U+AC00 가 (EA B0 80) + U+11A8 ᆨ (E1 86 A8) → 1 cluster, width=2
hangul_LV_T     | EA B0 80 E1 86 A8           | 4 → 2 | 0:6:2:T

# GB8: LVT × T — pre-composed LVT syllable + additional trailing jamo
# U+AC01 각 (EA B0 81) + U+11A8 (E1 86 A8) → 1 cluster, width=2
hangul_LVT_T    | EA B0 81 E1 86 A8           | 4 → 2 | 0:6:2:T

# Adversarial: L + non-Hangul should NOT compose
# U+1100 ᄀ (E1 84 80) + 'A' (41) → 2 clusters: [L=2 cells] + [A=1 cell]
hangul_L_ASCII  | E1 84 80 41                 | 4 → 3 | 0:3:2:T 3:1:1:T

# Adversarial: L + Extend + V must NOT compose (GB6–GB8 have no Extend*)
# UAX #29 test data: ÷ 1100 × 0308 ÷ 1160 ÷  (break between Extend and V)
# U+1100 (E1 84 80) + U+0308 combining diaeresis (CC 88) + U+1161 (E1 85 A1)
# → 2 clusters: [L+Extend=5 bytes=2 cells] + [V=3 bytes=1 cell]
hangul_L_extend_V_no_compose | E1 84 80 CC 88 E1 85 A1 | 4 → 3 | 0:5:2:T 5:3:1:T

# Standalone LV syllable (no composition)
# U+AC00 가 (EA B0 80) → 1 cluster, 2 cells
hangul_lv_alone | EA B0 80                    | 4 → 2 | 0:3:2:T
